DIAGNOSIS READY: Squamous Cell Carcinoma (SCC).

Given your age, the 2-month history of a growing, non-tender lesion, and your history of diabetes which impairs wound healing and immune response, the most likely diagnosis is Squamous Cell Carcinoma. I recommend we proceed immediately with a biopsy of the lesion for definitive histopathological confirmation.
